name: Jellyfin Federation
description: Aggregate content from multiple Jellyfin servers into unified virtual libraries
overview: The Jellyfin Federation Plugin allows you to create a unified media library by aggregating content from multiple remote Jellyfin servers. Stream content from any server without file synchronization.
changelog: Downloads from a Plex source that is offline no longer break the Downloads tab: it now says the server can't be reached, offline servers are marked in the picker, and downloads queued from them wait until it is back. Adds an opt-in adaptive player (Advanced → off by default) that can switch a movie to another friend's copy mid-play when that copy is clearly more reliable, preparing the new source first and showing a brief 'Switched to <server>' notice. Detail pages show which servers have a title and let you pick one instead of Auto. Learns when each friend's server is usually online and shows a forecast; adds a Log tab with this plugin's recent messages. Includes the Companion private file-sharing preview. UI uses solid colours throughout.
